title: Distance–Time Graphs
summary: Turn a journey into a picture: steep means fast, flat means stopped, and the slope is the speed.

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 8: Measurement of Time and Motion (distance–time graphs)

objectives: I can plot a distance–time graph from data.
I can describe a journey from its distance–time graph (moving, stopped, returning, faster or slower).
I can calculate speed from the slope (gradient) of a distance–time graph.
misconceptions: A distance–time graph is a picture of the path (a hill on the graph means going uphill).
A flat line means moving at a constant speed (it means stopped).
A steeper line means a longer journey (it means faster).
